'''Spellcraft''' is one of the magic systems of the Willverse.

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Magic is derived from a medium known as the [[Aether]]. Practitioners utilize fundamental skills such as basic [[Aetheric manipulation]] and [[Aether telekinesis]] to interact with this force. Manipulation is achieved through the use of symbols, which can be traced by hand or manifested as glowing sigils that serve various functions, such as providing alerts. These symbols can also be utilized within spinning discs for spell analysis or appear in various forms like swirling white discs, halos around structures, or patterns on surfaces. 

Spells can take many forms, including pathfinding spells that visualize routes, link to other individuals, or detect enemies. Some spells manifest as nebulous energy, while others create glowing roads. Specialized branches of magic exist, such as elementalism and sealing and [[binding]] magic; the latter is noted for being slower than elementalism and easier to resist using aura. 

A high level of wizardry is represented by the rank of [[Archmage]], a title held by individuals capable of utilizing large-scale magic. These practitioners can understand the sharing of [[Aetheric patterns]] and may hold certifications from organizations like the [[Galactic Union]]. 

The [[Aether]] is also capable of causing massive disruptions, such as twisting the sky during major rituals. Through specific Aetheric formulas, such as those inscribed on stone slabs, the [[Aether]] can facilitate rebirth, allowing a person to live two lives.}}
